name: Lapis Lazuli
source:
The king of the Blue Kingdom, which rules the Northern region. He thinks of himself less as a man and more as a tool for the maintenance of his kingdom. A proud realist. 

"My aim is to wipe out conflict from this world. That is all."

[Adapted from [url=https://game.mba-international.jp/monomagiacantabile/]official website[/url]]
